premises.text: Users assemble information by jumping site to site and stacking browser tabs and single-purpose apps
premises.evidence_span: forcing us to jump site to site, assembling bits and pieces of information

premises.text: VIRB reinvents surfing by weaving together services into an intelligent layer over the internet
premises.evidence_span: Verb is an intelligent layer over the internet that helps you get things done in one place

premises.text: Shared context across services enables continuous streams of cards, comparisons, and related actions without new tabs
premises.evidence_span: See how nice things are when we can share context across services?

premises.text: Collections let users save, share, and collaborate on activity streams across web and mobile with sync and deep links
premises.evidence_span: When I save this card into our shared collection around Disrupt, my team instantly gets a push notification

premises.text: Contextual bridges require semantic search/recommendations plus new UI and interaction paradigms
premises.evidence_span: To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations. But data alone is not enough. We also design from the ground up new user interfaces and interaction paradigms

value.text: Get things done in one place by surfing fluidly across interconnected services on any device
